svg.title: Frozen offline recommendation protocol and paired evaluation

cc:Work.dc:title: Frozen offline recommendation protocol and paired evaluation
cc:Work.dc:description: Offline Amazon V3 protocol only. The K=100 confidence interval is for paired per-user NDCG differences after averaging across three reranker seeds; it is not an interval for either marginal mean and does not support an online-performance claim.
